name: moderation
author: kirin
short: Warnings viewer, role-strip mutes, kicks, bans, and user info
description: Replaces Red's [p]warnings with a dated, paginated list and sends custom DMs for warns, mutes, kicks, bans, and unbans. Mutes strip a member's roles and give them back on unmute.
install_msg: Unload Red's Mod and Mutes cogs first, and load this after the Warnings cog.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the roles a member had when they were muted and when the mute ends, so the roles can be given back on unmute. Warnings are stored by Red's core Warnings cog.
